title: Candidate conservation ledger (D-132)
description: What became of every candidate each extraction run produced. Enforces candidates_in == proposals_out + merged + dropped_by_named_reason, staged across the cheap pass, synthesis and the strong pass. A run whose stage totals do not close is written to the manifest as status "broken", and tools/validate.ts fails. Every run in the manifest's run_history must appear here: a gap is recorded as a gap, and no run passes the invariant by having nothing said about it.

run_id.description: The run's start timestamp, the same key the manifest's run_history uses.

scope.description: The scope id the run was dispatched with (mechanism, pack, segment or effect).

candidates.description: candidates_cheap + candidates_strong. A sum of two stages, not a population. null when unknown.

cheap.description: null when the stage's numbers are genuinely unknown — which is not zero, and must not be written as zero. Runs before D-105 gated only the strong pass, so their cheap candidates were never counted.

balanced.description: Computed by checkLedgerBalance in lib/candidate-ledger.ts. Stored so the manifest's status is traceable to the arithmetic that set it; the validator recomputes it rather than trusting it.

synthesis_batch_failed.description: Grounded candidates lost with a synthesis call that failed.

synthesisStage.description: into_synthesis + expanded == consolidated + candidates_strong. Folding several cheap candidates into one composed candidate is legitimate; until D-132 it had no counter, so a fold and a lost candidate were indistinguishable from outside.

strongStage.description: candidates == proposed + proposed_enrich + merged_into_pending + held_low_confidence + held_non_transferable + failed_validation + dropped_ungrounded + dropped_volume_cap + dropped_draft_cap. held_non_transferable is optional: every run before D-160 predates the transferability pass and took no such measurement, and writing 0 into those runs would assert one.

proposed_enrich.description: Written as an enrichment of an approved artifact — an output file.

merged_into_pending.description: Absorbed into an earlier pending proposal — no output file.

held_non_transferable.description: Held by the transferability rules (D-160). Optional: absent means the run predates the pass, which is not the same as a run that judged nothing non-transferable.

dropped_draft_cap.description: Synthesis output past the first item, discarded by a draft mode (D-085).

reconstruction.description: How completely this run's ledger could be established: recorded (written by the run itself), reconstructed (complete, but worked out afterwards from committed evidence), partial (some fates could not be established), unreconstructable (none could). A reason is REQUIRED for anything short of "recorded" — that requirement is the substance of the rule.

candidate.description: One candidate's fate. No model text is stored: a refused candidate is already persisted in full under corpora/extraction/rejected/ (D-104), and this file answers what became of each one, not what it said.

fate.description: Must stay equal to CANDIDATE_FATES in lib/types.ts; tools/validate.ts asserts it.

reason.description: The failing grounding check; present only for dropped_ungrounded. Must stay equal to UNGROUNDED_DROP_REASONS in lib/types.ts.

attribution.description: Whether proposal_id was written by the run or worked out afterwards. A backfilled attribution is a reading of the evidence, not a record of what happened (D-131).
